State_Preconditions: Waybill DRAFT;charges and discount within authority
State_Transition: pricing version updated and NetAmount recalculated
Audit: freight charges taxes discount exchange rate before-after audited
Closure_Reason: Draft pricing is explicit and ledger-backed rather than an unexplained summary

State_Preconditions: Waybill APPROVED and not FINANCIALLY_CLOSED;reason and authority present
State_Transition: controlled pricing correction appended and financial links recalculated according to policy
Concurrency: Waybill RowVersion plus serialized financial correction
Audit: old/new pricing exchange rate discount reason approver and financial impact audited
Closure_Reason: No silent post-approval edit of financial values

State_Preconditions: Manifest DRAFT;all included lines valid;no blocked allocation;load plan complete for handover
Audit: final line totals manifest source and actor audited
Closure_Reason: Handover cannot occur before manifest finalization

State_Preconditions: Arrival receipt DRAFT;all expected lines have validated actual quantities and required evidence
Audit: expected actual differences evidence and finalizer audited
Closure_Reason: Finalizing a partial receipt does not falsely mark the whole waybill fully arrived

State_Preconditions: Trip ARRIVED;all manifest custody quantities accounted by arrival unload transfer return or approved exception;no open driver custody
Concurrency: Trip RowVersion plus serialized custody check
Audit: manifest reconciliation exception refs close actor and time audited
Closure_Reason: Trip settlement cannot start from an operationally open trip

Action_Arabic: إرسال أو إعادة محاولة إشعار العميل
State_Preconditions: eligible arrival readiness delivery or exception event exists;recipient contact and template valid
Idempotency: ClientOperationId required;same event/channel recipient operation returns prior result
Audit: template channel destination masked provider result attempt count and actor audited
Closure_Reason: Notification provider is configurable and failure does not rewrite the arrival event

State_Preconditions: Exception OPEN or INVESTIGATING;resolution and required evidence present
Audit: resolution actor evidence financial or quantity consequence audited
Closure_Reason: Resolution never deletes or edits accepted movement history

State_Preconditions: Accrual rows exist with immutable RuleSnapshot and source manifest execution;caller has approval authority
Audit: beneficiary basis amount snapshot approver and time audited
